title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-13
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Stunning soundboard recording captures an all‑time great early‑1970 show highlighted by a soaring Dark Star, monster The Other One, and fiery Turn On Your Love Light.
ai_review.review: The archive copy is a crystal‑clear stereo sound‑board mix (with a slight low‑frequency dip noted by a few listeners) that makes the performance feel almost like being at the Fillmore.  Musically this night is revered for its 60‑minute Dark Star segueing into an epic The Other One, plus a blistering Turn On Your Love Light and tight acoustic set – performances many reviewers call “the best” of any era.  Overall the show is described as one of the Dead’s most inventive, energetic, and emotionally resonant concerts.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews overwhelmingly praise both the musical performance (standout Dark Star, The Other One, Lovelight) and the sound‑board audio quality; only minor technical complaints appear, yielding a near‑perfect combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo sound‑board mix that is clear, balanced and album‑ready. A few reviewers note a slight loss of low‑frequency punch compared with other copies, but overall the audio is described as crystal‑clear and faithful to the live experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early electric set leads into a moving acoustic segment, then returns to an explosive second set where Dark Star morphs into The Other One and culminates with a high‑energy Lovelight showcase; the pacing is praised for its dynamic contrasts and seamless transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for his inventive lead guitar work, especially during the expansive Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass playing described as “fantastic” and a core part of the improvisational flow; no criticism noted.
band_member_comments.Bob: Credited with driving the band through The Other One with powerful rhythm‑guitar/vocal energy.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drumming highlighted during Turn On Your Love Light and the “Pig Pen” showcase, praised for its tightness and excitement.
